knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Low water can draw air into the pump. The level is confirmed and topped up within the plan before the pump runs. Running first, removing the basket or changing the filter pressure does not address the cause.
A reading is only meaningful with the method and timing that produced it. Recording these lets you spot readings that were taken in the wrong conditions.
Cloudy water makes the reading unreliable, and the adjustment is outside this visit's authority. Recording and referral is the correct response.

practicalCriteria: Water level is recorded and confirmed before the pump is run, with the decision stated
Skimmer and strainer baskets are emptied, inspected and returned with lids sealed
Chemistry readings are recorded with time, method and tester, and an out-of-plan result is referred with a reason
The visit record lists every task not completed and the reason for each
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Visit record for one supervised home pool visit
Observation or photo of the level check and basket inspection, where the owner agrees
Referral note where a referral trigger applied
stopWorkCriteria: Pump run without checking the water level
Chemistry adjusted outside the written plan
Pool left open to bathers while the floor cannot be made out or the water is clearly unsafe
Water emptied from the pool without written professional advice
